hypothesis: An evidence gate trained on separate interventions' response consistency can distinguish genuine aliases from agents with indistinguishable static signatures and first-context responses, improving typed graph reasoning against strong programmed response controls.

training.learned_features: squared discrepancies of static identity context, response to environmental intervention 1, response to intervention 2, response-contrast discrepancy; source defines these attributes, model only weights them

original.impostors: static/first-intervention matched but second intervention response diverges

controls: exact coded typed reachability source reference
